subject.title: fix(browser): support GPT-5.6 Sol Pro effort

question: Should Oracle permanently expose `--browser-thinking-time pro` only for explicitly selected GPT-5.6 Sol runs and fail before browser acquisition for every incompatible model or strategy?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but adding a new CLI-visible effort mode and defining its strict compatibility policy requires product intent that implementation evidence alone cannot establish.

options.title: Approve the CLI-only contract
options.body: Keep `pro` available only through explicit CLI/browser input and require GPT-5.6 Sol with model strategy `select`.

options.title: Defer to inventory redesign
options.body: Pause this mode until the broader model and effort discovery direction in https://github.com/steipete/oracle/pull/319 is resolved.

recommendation.title: Approve the CLI-only contract
recommendation.body: Keep `pro` available only through explicit CLI/browser input and require GPT-5.6 Sol with model strategy `select`.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent GPT-5.6 release behavior, browser-picker history, CLI configuration surface, and release policy point to steipete as the best available decision owner.
